paragraphs: Century Communities, Inc., a Delaware corporation (which we refer to as "we," "us," "our," "CCS," or the "Company"), together with its subsidiaries, is engaged in the development, design, construction, marketing and sale of single-family attached and detached homes in 16 states. In many of our projects, in addition to building homes, we entitle and develop the underlying land. We build and sell homes under our Century Communities and Century Complete brands.

Our Century Communities brand has an emphasis on serving the affordable homebuilding market but offers a wide range of buyer profiles including: entry-level, first and second time move-up, and lifestyle homebuyers, and provides our homebuyers with the limited ability to personalize their homes through certain option and upgrade selections. Our Century Complete brand targets entry-level homebuyers, primarily sells homes through retail studios, centralized locations and the internet, and generally provides no option or upgrade selections.

Our homebuilding operations are organized into the following five reportable segments: West, Mountain, Texas, Southeast, and Century Complete. Our indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, Inspire Home Loans Inc., Parkway Title, LLC, IHL Home Insurance Agency, LLC, and IHL Escrow Inc., which provide mortgage, title, insurance brokerage and escrow services, respectively, primarily to our homebuyers, have been identified as our Financial Services segment. Additionally, our Century Living segment is engaged in the development, construction, management, and sales of multi-family rental properties, currently all located in Colorado.

While we offer homes that appeal to a broad range of entry-level, move-up, and lifestyle homebuyers, our offerings are heavily weighted towards providing affordable housing options in each of our homebuyer segments. Additionally, we prefer building move-in-ready homes over built-to-order homes, which we believe allows for a faster construction process, advantageous pricing with subcontractors, and shortened time period from home sale to home delivery, thus allowing our customers greater certainty on their financing and allowing us to more appropriately price the homes and deploy our capital. Of the 10,387 new homes delivered during 2025, approximately 94% of homes delivered had purchase prices below the Federal Housing Administration-insured mortgage limits and approximately 99% of homes delivered were built as move-in ready homes.

We are one of the largest homebuilders in the United States and our common shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "CCS." Since our initial public offering in 2014, we have expanded geographically through the acquisitions of other homebuilders and organic entrance into new markets.
As of December 31, 2025, we operated in the 16 states and over 45 markets depicted below:
We operate within the following reportable segments for our homebuilding operations: West (California and Washington)
Mountain (Arizona, Colorado, Nevada and Utah) Texas Southeast (Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee)
Century Complete (Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, North Carolina, and South Carolina)
Financial Services, which provides mortgage, title, insurance brokerage, and escrow services to our homebuyers.

Century Living, which is engaged in the development, construction, management, and sales of multi-family rental properties. Beginning in the first quarter of 2025, we have separately reported our Century Living segment as a reportable segment, which was previously included in our Corporate segment, in order to reflect the distinct nature of our multi-family rental operations.

Our Corporate operations are a non-operating segment, as it serves to support our homebuilding operations, and to a lesser extent our Financial Services operations, through various functions, such as our executive, finance, treasury, human resources, accounting and legal departments. See Note 2 – Reporting Segments in the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements for further detail on our reportable segments.

During the year ended December 31, 2025, we delivered 10,792 residential units, comprised of 10,387 new homes, 105 previously leased rental homes, and 300 multi-family units delivered through our Century Living business. Our Century Complete brand targets entry-level homebuyers, primarily sells homes through retail studios, centralized locations and the internet, and generally provides no option or upgrade selections.

Our homebuilding operations are organized into the following five reportable segments: West, Mountain, Texas, Southeast, and Century Complete. Our indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, Inspire Home Loans Inc., Parkway Title, LLC, IHL Home Insurance Agency, LLC, and IHL Escrow Inc., which provide mortgage, title, insurance brokerage, and escrow services, respectively, primarily to our homebuyers, have been identified as our Financial Services segment. Additionally, our Century Living segment is engaged in the development, construction, management, and sales of multi-family rental properties, currently all located in Colorado.

While we offer homes that appeal to a broad range of entry-level, move-up, and lifestyle homebuyers, our offerings are heavily weighted towards providing affordable housing options in each of our homebuyer segments. Additionally, we prefer building move-in-ready homes over built-to-order homes, which we believe allows for a faster construction process, advantageous pricing with subcontractors, and shortened time period from home sale to home delivery, thus allowing our customers greater certainty on their financing and allowing us to more appropriately price the homes and deploy our capital. Of the 10,387 new homes delivered during the year ended December 31, 2025, approximately 94% of our deliveries were made to entry-level homebuyers that were below the Federal Housing Administration-insured mortgage limits and approximately 99% of homes delivered were built as move-in ready homes.

Market conditions in the homebuilding industry have continued to be impacted by elevated mortgage rates, macro-economic and geopolitical uncertainty, and broader concerns about affordability by homebuyers. Amidst these market conditions, we experienced a slowing in demand during the year ended December 31, 2025, as net new home contracts (new home contracts net of cancellations) for the year ended 2025 decreased 3.3%, respectively, as compared to the prior year. Still, there remains an underlying need for affordable new homes, supported by solid demographic trends, and we have continued to provide, when necessary, incentive offerings across our communities, including discounts on base home prices, lot premiums, options and upgrades, and financing incentives, including interest rate buydowns and closing cost concessions. In the latter half of 2025, we have also experienced increased acceptance to adjustable-rate mortgages among our homebuyers. During the year ended December 31, 2025, cycle times were in the approximately three- to four-month timeframe.

We anticipate the homebuilding markets in each of our operating segments will continue to be tied to both the macro-economic environment and the local economy, and we expect our operating strategy will continue to adapt to market changes, though we cannot provide any assurance that our strategies will remain consistent or continue to be successful. We believe future demand for our homes remains uncertain as future economic, market and geopolitical conditions remain uncertain, in particular with respect to inflation; the impact of potential future increases or decreases to the U.S. Federal funds interest rate by the U.S. Federal Reserve; interest rates; availability and cost of mortgage loans to homebuyers; financial, credit and mortgage markets; the extent to which and how long

government monetary directives and actions will impact the U.S. economy; the effect of significant new tariffs and/or duties; consumer confidence; wage growth; household formations; levels of new and existing homes for sale; prevailing home and rental prices; availability and cost of land, labor and construction materials; demographic trends; housing demand; the possibility of an economic recession or another U.S. governmental shutdown; and other factors, including those described elsewhere in this Form 10-K. Specifically, changes in mortgage interest rates impact the costs of owning a home and affect the purchasing power of our customers and could impact homebuyer confidence. Changes in demand for our homes or cancellations due to mortgage interest rates, consumer confidence or otherwise affect our operating results in future periods, including our net sales, home deliveries, gross margin, origination volume of and revenues from our Financial Services segment, and net income.

In October 2025, certain new tariffs took effect related to various imported products used in the homebuilding industry, including cabinets, lumber, and certain other wood products. As of the date of the filing of this report, we have not experienced significant cost increases or supply chain disruptions for raw materials; however, we could experience increases in the costs of materials utilized for the construction of our homes and/or supply chain disruptions that, in turn, would impact our business and our consolidated financial statements in future reporting periods. Additionally, during the latter half of 2025, the U.S. Federal Reserve reduced the U.S. Federal funds interest rate, and we cannot provide any assurance as to the impact of any future potential changes to the U.S. Federal funds interest rate on mortgage rates or our current or future business. The potential extent and effect of these and other factors on our business is highly uncertain and outside our control, and our past performance may not be indicative of our future results.

We believe we are well-positioned to benefit from the favorable demographics that support the need for new affordable housing. We believe our operations are prepared to withstand volatility in future market conditions as a result of our product offerings, which both span the home buying segment and focus on affordable price points, our efficiencies in direct construction costs and cycle times, and our current and future inventories of attractive land positions.

paragraphs: Century Communities, Inc., 一間 Delaware 公司（以下簡稱為 "we," "us," "our," "CCS," 或 the "Company"），與其子公司共同從事在 16 個州開發、設計、建造、行銷與銷售單戶附屬與獨立住宅。在許多我們的專案中，除了建造住宅外，我們也取得土地開發許可並開發底層土地。我們以 Century Communities 和 Century Complete 品牌建造並銷售住宅。
我們的 Century Communities 品牌著重於服務可負擔住宅市場，但提供廣泛的買家類型，包括：初購者、首次與第二次購屋上車者，以及生活方式購屋者，並為購屋者提供有限的自訂能力，透過某些選項與升級選擇。我們的 Century Complete 品牌則針對初購者，主要透過零售展示間、集中地點與互聯網銷售住宅，並通常不提供選項或升級選擇。

我們的住宅建造業務組織為以下五個應報告分部：西區、山區、德州、東南區與 Century Complete。我們間接全資擁有子公司 Inspire Home Loans Inc., Parkway Title, LLC, IHL Home Insurance Agency, LLC, 和 IHL Escrow Inc., 這些子公司分別為我們的購屋者提供房貸、地權、保險經紀與不動產過戶服務，已被歸類為我們的金融服務分部。此外，我們的 Century Living 分部從事多戶出租住宅的開發、建造、管理與銷售，目前所有住宅皆位於科羅拉多州。

雖然我們提供住宅以吸引廣泛的初購者、上車者與生活方式購屋者，但我們的產品在每個購屋者類型中都高度傾向於提供可負擔住宅選項。此外，我們偏好建造即買即住住宅而非預訂建造住宅，我們認為這可加快建造過程、取得 subcontractor 的優勢價格，並縮短從住宅銷售到住宅交付的時間，使我們的客戶在貸款上有更高的確定性，並使我們能更恰當地為住宅定價與運用資本。在 2025 年交付的 10,387 間新住宅中，約有 94% 的住宅銷售價格低於美國聯邦住宅管理局擔保房貸上限，約有 99% 的住宅為即買即住住宅。
我們是美國最大的住宅建造商之一，本公司普通股在紐約證券交易所交易，代碼為 "CCS." 自 2014 年首次公開發行以來，我們透過收購其他住宅建造商與有機進入新市場來擴張地理範圍。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們在以下 16 個州與超過 45 個市場營運：
我們的住宅建造業務分為以下應報告分部：西區（加利福尼亞州與華盛頓州）
山區（亞利桑那州、科羅拉多州、內華達州與猶他州） 德州 東南區（佛羅裏達州、喬治亞州、北卡羅來納州、南卡羅來納州與田納西州）
Century Complete（Alabama、Arizona、Florida、Georgia、Indiana、Kentucky、Michigan、North Carolina、以及 South Carolina）
Financial Services，提供房貸、過戶、保險經紀以及不動產過戶服務給我們的購屋者。
Century Living，從事多戶出租住宅的開發、建設、管理與銷售。自 2025 年第一季起，我們已將 Century Living 作為應報告分部單獨報告，此分部先前包含在本公司分部中，以反映我們多戶出租住宅業務的獨特性。
本公司運作為非營運分部，因其主要用以支援我們的住宅建設業務，並在較小程度上支援 Financial Services 業務，透過如執行長、財務、財務長、人力資源、會計與法律部門等各項功能。有關我們應報告分部的更多細節，請參閱財務報表附註中的 Note 2 – Reporting Segments。

paragraphs: 本公司從事單戶附屬及獨立住宅的開發、設計、興建、行銷與銷售業務，業務範圍遍及16個州。在許多專案中，除了興建住宅外，我們亦取得土地開發權並進行土地開發。我們以 Century Communities 及 Century Complete 品牌興建與銷售住宅。Century Communities 品牌主要服務可負擔住宅市場，但提供廣泛的買家類型選擇，包括：初購者、首次與第二次購屋者及生活方式購屋者，並提供買家有限度的自訂化選擇，透過特定的選項與升級選項。Century Complete 品牌則針對初購者，主要透過零售展示間、集中地點及網路銷售住宅，並通常不提供選項或升級選擇。

本公司住宅興建業務分為以下五個應報告分部：西區、山區、德州、東南區及 Century Complete。我們的間接 wholly-owned 子公司 Inspire Home Loans Inc.、Parkway Title, LLC、IHL Home Insurance Agency, LLC 及 IHL Escrow Inc.，分別提供房貸、地價、保險經紀及不動產過戶服務，主要服務我們的買家，已被歸類為財務服務分部。此外，本公司 Century Living 分部從事多戶出租住宅的開發、興建、管理與銷售，目前所有住宅均位於科羅拉多州。

雖然我們提供的住宅吸引廣泛的初購者、購屋者及生活方式購屋者，但我們的產品在每個買家類型中均高度重視提供可負擔住宅的選擇。此外，我們偏好興建即時可入住住宅而非預訂興建住宅，我們認為這可縮短施工時間、取得 subcontractor 的優勢價格，並縮短從銷售到交付的時間，使買家在貸款上有更高的確定性，同時讓我們能更恰當地定價住宅並運用資本。在截至2025年12月31日的會計年度內，總計交付了10,387間新住宅，約94%的交付為初購者所購買，且這些住宅的貸款額低於聯邦住宅管理局擔保的房貸上限，約99%的住宅為即時可入住住宅。

住宅興建產業的市場狀況持續受到高房貸利率、總體經濟與地緣政治不確定性，以及買家對負擔能力的廣泛關注所影響。在這些市場條件下，我們在截至2025年12月31日的會計年度內經歷了需求減緩，因為2025年度的淨新住宅合約（新住宅合約扣除取消合約）較前一年減少3.3%。然而，仍有對可負擔新住宅的基礎需求，這由強勁的世代趨勢所支撐，我們持續在社區中提供必要的激勵措施，包括住宅基準價格折扣、土地 premium、選項與升級選擇，以及貸款激勵措施，包括利率折扣與 closing cost 福利。在2025年下半年，我們也觀察到買家對浮動利率房貸的接受度提高。在截至2025年12月31日的會計年度內，建屋週期約為三至四個月。

我們預期各營運分部的住宅建造市場將持續與總體經濟環境及地方經濟相關聯，我們預期營運策略將持續適應市場變化，不過我們無法提供任何保證，說明我們的策略將保持一致或持續成功。我們認為未來對我們住宅的需求仍然不確定，因為未來的經濟、市場及地緣政治條件仍然不確定，特別是與通貨膨脹；美國聯邦儲備系統可能未來提高或降低美國聯邦基金利率的影響；利率；房貸貸款對購屋者的可得性與成本；金融、信貸及房貸市場；政府貨幣政策與行動對美國經濟的影響程度與持續時間

新興的重大關稅與/或進口稅；消費者信心；工資成長；家庭形成數量；新屋與現有屋上市數量；住宅與租金價格；土地、勞動力與建設材料的可得性與成本；人口趨勢；住宅需求；經濟衰退或美國政府關閉的可能性；及其他因素，包括在本10-K表格其他處所描述的那些因素。特別是，房貸利率的變化會影響住宅所有權的成本，並影響我們客戶的購買力，並可能影響購屋者的信心。對我們住宅需求的變化或因房貸利率、消費者信心或其他原因而取消，會影響我們未來期間的營運結果，包括我們的淨銷售額、住宅交貨數量、毛利率、財務服務分部的房貸發放量與收入，以及淨利潤。

2025年10月，與住宅建造產業中使用的各種進口產品相關的新關稅生效，包括櫃檯、木材及某些其他木製產品。截至本報告提交日，我們尚未經歷顯著的成本增加或供應鏈中斷；然而，我們可能經歷用於建造我們住宅的材料成本增加及/或供應鏈中斷，這會影響我們的業務及我們的合併財務報表在未來的會計期間。此外，在2025年下半年，美國聯邦儲備系統降低了美國聯邦基金利率，我們無法提供任何保證，說明未來潛在的美國聯邦基金利率變動對房貸利率或我們目前或未來業務的影響。這些及其他因素對我們業務的潛在影響程度與效果極其不確定，且超出我們的控制範圍，我們的過去表現可能無法反映我們未來的結果。
我們認為我們處於有利位置，可從支持新興可負擔住宅需求的有利人口結構中受益。我們認為我們的營運已準備好應對未來市場條件的波動，這是因為我們的產品組合涵蓋住宅購屋市場，並專注於可負擔價格點，我們在直接建設成本與週期時間方面的效率，以及我們目前及未來的優質土地庫存。

惡劣天氣與地質條件可能提高成本、延宕工程並降低住宅需求，對本公司營運及營運成果產生負面影響。

與我們財務服務業務相關的風險

我們的財務服務業務面臨各種額外的風險。
我們未能識別、招募、留住並培養高技能且具備專業能力的員工及承包商，可能會對我們的服務標準及業務產生不利影響。
與政府機構、法規、法律及合規事項相關的風險
我們擁有大量負債，並預期會持續使用槓桿來執行我們的業務策略，這會限制我們的營運，並可能對我們的業務產生其他重要後果。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務、營運成果、財務狀況、股票價格及未來展望，皆面臨風險與不確定性。下列所描述之風險並非本公司唯一所面臨之風險。其他風險，包括目前尚未知悉或認為不重要之風險，可能會對本公司之業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大且不利之影響。本節包含「預測性陳述」，應與本10-K表單之「預測性陳述警示」節及本表單其餘內容一併閱讀。下列摘要並非完整，應與後續所列之風險因素一併閱讀。
本公司住宅之需求波動可能持續對本公司之業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大影響。
總體經濟條件之不利變化，包括特別是通貨膨脹、利率及就業率之變動，可能持續降低本公司住宅之需求，因而持續對本公司之業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大且不利之影響。
由於許多買方需要房貸融資，本公司住宅之銷售取決於可取得合理價格之房貸融資。
本公司之成功取決於本公司能否成功識別並取得具吸引力之土地與地塊，以合理價格購入，管理本公司之土地與地塊存貨，依照預期時間表與預算開發社區，並適應住宅購屋模式與趨勢、人口成長率及其他人口統計資料之變動。
本公司之地理集中性使本公司面臨區域性經濟、法規及環境風險。
